headline: UK Budget to Allocate £1 Billion for Social and Affordable Housing
summary: The UK government's upcoming budget will feature £1 billion for social and affordable housing, lifting overall funding for its 10-year housing development program to more than £40 billion.
why: UK budgetary commitments direct capital spending across the public sector. Increased statutory funding for residential building affects UK housebuilding activity, planning approvals, and related construction supply chains.

impacts.name: UK Construction
impacts.why: Additional government capital spending provides direct contract revenue for social home builders and building materials suppliers.
